isu is an issue tracker with no database.

Issues are folders inside the repository, so the pull request that fixes a bug
also closes it, in the same diff. Status is never stored: it is derived from
what trunk and every branch say about an issue, which is why a claim is a branch
and not a row in a table.

Every command supports --json, because half the people reading this are agents.
The shape is documented in docs/json.md and is a contract.

Usage:
  isu [flags]
  isu [command]

Available Commands:
  board       every issue, grouped by derived status
  claim       say you are working on an issue, before you start
  comment     add a comment to an issue
  drop        say an issue will not be fixed, and why
  help        Help about any command
  init        write .isu.yml, so that everything else works
  new         file a new issue
  ready       the issues nothing is blocking, most urgent first
  resolve     say this branch fixes an issue
  show        one issue in full
  triage      set who owns an issue, what blocks it, and how urgent it is
  unclaim     release a claim, keeping the branch

Flags:
      --fetch         update remote refs before reading
  -h, --help          help for isu
      --json          print newline-delimited JSON instead of text
      --no-color      never colour the output
      --ref string    the ref isu treats as trunk (default: main, else master, else HEAD)
      --repo string   the repository to read (default: the working directory)
  -v, --version       version for isu

Use "isu [command] --help" for more information about a command.
